title: 구청 민원실 번호표: 내 차례는 언제예요?
objective: You can take a number ticket and use -는구나/-구나 to react to something new.
summary: Take a number ticket at a district office and react with -는구나/-구나.
setting: Anna, a foreign resident, goes to the civil service office (민원실) at her district office (구청) to get a document. Her Korean friend Minsu goes with her. The two friends talk in casual speech (반말).

task.title: Wait for your turn
task.line: Use the words and the -는구나/-구나 ending from page 1 to complete each task.

words.meaning: number ticket (the paper that shows your place in line)
words.exampleMeaning: You must not lose your number ticket.

words.meaning: to take (a ticket from a machine)
words.exampleMeaning: Take a number ticket from the machine.

words.meaning: number of people waiting (shown on the ticket)
words.example: 지금은 대기 인원이 두 명밖에 없어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Right now only two people are waiting.
I left my ID at home.

words.meaning: casual ending for something you just noticed (to a friend or to yourself). Use -는구나 after action verbs and -구나 after adjectives, 이다 and 아니다 (차례구나, 아니구나). For the past, use -았/었구나.
words.exampleMeaning: Oh, there aren't many people today.

dialogue.korean: 와, 사람이 정말 많네. 바로 창구로 가면 돼?
dialogue.meaning: Wow, there are so many people. Can I just go straight to a counter?

dialogue.korean: 아니, 먼저 저 기계에서 번호표를 뽑아야 돼.
dialogue.meaning: No, first you have to take a number ticket from that machine.

dialogue.korean: 벌써 내 차례구나! 생각보다 빨리 됐네.
dialogue.meaning: It's my turn already! That was faster than I thought.

exercises: Change the word in brackets using -는구나/-구나: ① (Looking at the screen) 아, 내 번호가 벌써 ____. (지나가다, past) ② 이 기계는 버튼이 정말 ____. (크다) ③ 사람들이 다 여기 앉아서 ____. (기다리다)
Fill in each blank with 번호표, 신분증 or 대기 인원: ① 이름을 확인해야 하니까 ____을 보여 주세요. ② 앞에 ____이 많아서 한참 기다렸어요. ③ 들어가자마자 기계에서 ____를 뽑았어요.
Your friend says, '여기는 서류 발급 창구가 아니야.' Answer with a short reaction using -구나: 아, 여기가 ____.
Put the steps in order: ① 창구로 가서 서류를 신청해요. ② 나온 번호표를 가져가요. ③ 화면에 내 번호가 나오는지 봐요. ④ 기계에서 업무 버튼을 눌러요.
answers: ① 지나갔구나 ② 크구나 ③ 기다리는구나
① 신분증 ② 대기 인원 ③ 번호표
